tools.name: m365_about
tools.description: Returns information about this MCP M365 server

tools.name: m365_auth_start
tools.description: Authenticate with Microsoft Graph API to access Outlook data. Initiates the OAuth flow and persists tokens to disk on success — registered under the `write` role because of that token-store mutation.

force.description: Force re-authentication even if already authenticated

tools.name: m365_auth_status
tools.description: Check the current authentication status with Microsoft Graph API. Returns presence + scope/expiry metadata only — never the token values.

tools.name: m365_calendar_events_list
tools.description: Lists upcoming events from your calendar

count.description: Number of events to retrieve (default: 10, max: 50)

startDateTime.description: ISO 8601 start date/time for the query range (default: now)

endDateTime.description: ISO 8601 end date/time for the query range (default: startDateTime + 30 days)

tools.name: m365_calendar_event_accept
tools.description: Accepts a calendar event

eventId.description: The ID of the event to accept

comment.description: Optional comment for accepting the event

tools.name: m365_calendar_event_decline
tools.description: Declines a calendar event. `dry_run` defaults to true — pass false to actually decline; dry-run fetches the event metadata and returns what would happen.

eventId.description: The ID of the event to decline

comment.description: Optional comment for declining the event

dry_run.description: Preview only; do not decline. Default true — pass false to actually decline.

tools.name: m365_calendar_event_create
tools.description: Creates a new calendar event

start.description: The start time of the event in ISO 8601 format

end.description: The end time of the event in ISO 8601 format

body.description: Optional body content for the event

tools.name: m365_email_messages_list
tools.description: Lists recent emails from your inbox

folder.description: Email folder to list. Use well-known names like 'inbox' or a full custom path like 'Top/Sub' (default: 'inbox')

folderId.description: Optional explicit Graph folder ID. If provided, this is used instead of folder path resolution.

count.description: Number of emails to retrieve (default: 10, max: 1000)

includeCount.description: Include total matching count from Microsoft Graph (@odata.count). Default: false

tools.name: m365_email_messages_search
tools.description: Search for emails using various criteria

query.description: Search query text to find in emails

folder.description: Email folder to search in. Use well-known names like 'inbox' or a full custom path like 'Top/Sub' (default: 'inbox')

folderId.description: Optional explicit Graph folder ID. If provided, this is used instead of folder path resolution.

from.description: Filter by sender email address or name

to.description: Filter by recipient email address or name

hasAttachments.description: Filter to only emails with attachments

receivedAfter.description: Filter to emails received on or after this ISO 8601 timestamp

receivedBefore.description: Filter to emails received on or before this ISO 8601 timestamp

count.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 1000)

tools.name: m365_email_message_get
tools.description: Reads the content of a specific email. HTML emails are securely sanitized to extract only visible text, preventing prompt injection attacks via hidden content.

id.description: ID of the email to read

includeRawHtml.description: Include raw HTML content (UNSAFE - for debugging only, may contain hidden prompt injection content)

tools.name: m365_email_message_send
tools.description: Composes and sends a new email. Supports both plain text and HTML content.

to.description: Comma-separated list of recipient email addresses

cc.description: Comma-separated list of CC recipient email addresses

bcc.description: Comma-separated list of BCC recipient email addresses

body.description: Email body content (plain text or HTML)

isHtml.description: Set to true to send as HTML, false for plain text. If not specified, auto-detects based on <html> tag presence.

saveToSentItems.description: Whether to save the email to sent items

tools.name: m365_email_draft_create
tools.description: Creates and saves an email draft in Outlook

to.description: Comma-separated list of recipient email addresses

cc.description: Comma-separated list of CC recipient email addresses

bcc.description: Comma-separated list of BCC recipient email addresses

body.description: Draft email body content (can be plain text or HTML)

tools.name: m365_email_message_mark_read
tools.description: Marks an email as read or unread

id.description: ID of the email to mark as read/unread

isRead.description: Whether to mark as read (true) or unread (false). Default: true

tools.name: m365_email_folders_list
tools.description: Lists mail folders in your Outlook account

includeItemCounts.description: Include counts of total and unread items

tools.name: m365_email_folder_create
tools.description: Creates a new mail folder

name.description: Name of the folder to create

parentFolder.description: Optional parent folder path (default is root)

tools.name: m365_email_folder_rename
tools.description: Renames an existing mail folder

folder.description: Folder to rename. Use a full custom path like 'Top/Sub'

newName.description: New leaf name for the folder

tools.name: m365_email_messages_move
tools.description: Moves emails from one folder to another

emailIds.description: Comma-separated list of email IDs to move

targetFolder.description: Folder path to move emails to

sourceFolder.description: Optional source folder path (default is inbox)

tools.name: m365_onedrive_items_list
tools.description: List files and folders in OneDrive at a specific path

path.description: Path to list (e.g., '/Documents', '/Photos'). Defaults to root.

count.description: Number of items to retrieve (default: 25, max: 50)

tools.name: m365_onedrive_items_search
tools.description: Search for files in OneDrive by name or content

count.description: Number of results to return (default: 25, max: 50)

tools.name: m365_onedrive_item_download
tools.description: Get a download URL for a file in OneDrive. Either 'itemId' or 'path' must be provided.

itemId.description: ID of the item to download

path.description: Path to the file (alternative to itemId)

tools.name: m365_onedrive_item_upload
tools.description: Upload a small file (< 4MB) to OneDrive

tools.name: m365_onedrive_item_upload_large
tools.description: Upload a large file (> 4MB) to OneDrive using chunked upload

tools.name: m365_onedrive_item_share
tools.description: Create a sharing link for a file or folder in OneDrive

itemId.description: ID of the item to share

path.description: Path to the item (alternative to itemId)

tools.name: m365_onedrive_folder_create
tools.description: Create a new folder in OneDrive

path.description: Parent folder path (e.g., '/Documents'). Defaults to root.

tools.name: m365_email_rules_list
tools.description: Lists inbox rules in your Outlook account

includeDetails.description: Include detailed rule conditions and actions

tools.name: m365_email_rule_create
tools.description: Creates a new inbox rule

name.description: Name of the rule to create

fromAddresses.description: Comma-separated list of sender email addresses for the rule

containsSubject.description: Subject text the email must contain

hasAttachments.description: Whether the rule applies to emails with attachments

moveToFolder.description: Name of the folder to move matching emails to

markAsRead.description: Whether to mark matching emails as read

isEnabled.description: Whether the rule should be enabled after creation (default: true)

sequence.description: Order in which the rule is executed (lower numbers run first, default: 100). Graph rejects negative values.

tools.name: m365_email_rules_reorder
tools.description: Changes the execution order of an existing inbox rule

ruleName.description: Name of the rule to modify

sequence.description: New sequence value for the rule (lower numbers run first). Graph rejects negative values.

content.text:
MCP M365 Server v1.0.0

Provides access to Microsoft 365 services through Microsoft Graph API:
- Outlook (email, calendar, folders, rules)
- OneDrive (files, folders, sharing)

Modular architecture for improved maintainability.
